In the reviewed tree, `sha256sum docs/reports/launch-readiness/2026-06-27-v1-data-asset-contract-map.md` is `96b91bc7ea9d6546bbd93fdbcd6a965c37cd6d734cdaa58e4c3089f4746c0359`, but this source-artifact entry records `01a699ec97ed45cbd22dc0d782bf8309bf2e3277c1dbcacdd1b74f55d2eac780` after this commit also edits that Markdown file. Any provenance or audit replay that verifies these hashes will reject the contract map or trust the wrong version; the same stale value is copied into the validator result and local schema projection contract, so these entries should be refreshed after the final Markdown changes.
